description: We were told that everything would be done for us, but in the end, we had to do the work ourselves.
summary: Abandoned, but Not Forgotten is a kid-friendly educational project created for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 by team Robumo Idealni Zvity, combining an interactive web application and a companion slide presentation to introduce children to the history and scientific legacy of NASA's inactive spacecraft across the Solar System. Designed for young learners, both formats showcase spacecraft and rovers resting on the Moon, Mars, and in deep space—explaining in simple, engaging terms why returning them to Earth is impractical, how they operated beyond their planned lifespans, and why their groundbreaking discoveries and cultural value make them historic milestones rather than mere space debris
details: The project consists of a live interactive web application built and hosted via Google AI Studio (https://abandoned-but-not-forgotten-nasa-space-apps-2026.ai.studio/) and a companion slide presentation (Presentation_Abandon...) stored in the Google Drive project folder (NASA Space Apps Challenge) alongside supporting materials (Images, Project Overview, and Sources of information). Both the web app and the presentation are structured for easy child-friendly navigation and storytelling across Lunar, Martian, and deep-space missions, and are openly accessible via direct links without requiring login or special permissions.
